chapters.title: About this Discovery Title
chapters.content:
The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo is a contemporary work by Taylor Jenkins Reid (2017).

Aging and reclusive Hollywood movie icon Evelyn Hugo is finally ready to tell the truth about her glamorous and scandalous life to an unknown journalist.

Categorized under: Historical Fiction, Romance, Drama.
